title: Sugestión: el confundido golpea al apuntado
description: docs/animas/tecnopata/README.md § Sugestión. Fight tester, three dogs, Tecnópata with Confusión, Control remoto and Sugestión; the first dog confused and the third aimed at by hand. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: window.ui = window.gerard.battleUI; window.turn = id => document.querySelector('#battle .turn-meta')?.textContent === 'TU TURNO' && document.querySelector('.battle-dock[data-dock="1"]')?.dataset.member === id; ui.tweak(s => { s.foes.forEach(f => { f.hp = f.maxHp = 600; }); s.foes[0].timed = { ...s.foes[0].timed, confusion: { level: 1, left: 30, next: 30 } }; s.aimed = s.foes[2].id; });

steps.caption: The first dog is confused (?) and the third carries Sugestión's mark: two fine cyan lines converging on a point, on the foe the party last aimed at
Both hold on; in the foes' turn the confused dog strikes the third (the one marked), not one at random: «Sugestión · Pasiva» over Aitor in cyan, and the message names the pair
After the foes' turn: the third dog took the confused one's blow
